title: Smart Data Models - Catena-X - SingleLevelUsageAsBuilt
description: The aspect provides the information in which parent part(s)/product(s)the given item is assembled in. Could be a 1:1 relationship in terms of an e.g. a brake component or 1:n for e.g. coatings. The parent item must refer to an object from as-built lifecycle phase, i.e. a batch or a serialized part. (Catena-X aspect model urn:samm:io.catenax.industry_core.single_level_usage_as_built:4.0.0#SingleLevelUsageAsBuilt, translated from the SAMM-generated JSON Schema; aspect property names and nested structures are kept verbatim.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity. Built as urn:ngsi-ld:<type>:<UUID of the Catena-X digital twin (globalAssetId without the urn:uuid: prefix)>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'SingleLevelUsageAsBuilt'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

parentItems.description:
Property. Model:'urn:samm:io.catenax.industry_core.single_level_usage_as_built:4.0.0#parentItems'. Set of parent items, in which the given child object is assembled in (one structural level up).

For serialized items the list should contain only one parent item.
As different subsets of a batch might be used by a customer in different items this is a list.

items.description: Catena-X ID and meta data of the parent item.

quantity.description: Quantity of which the child part is assembled into the parent part. In general it is '1' for serialized parts.

value.description: The quantity value associated with the unit.

unit.description: The unit of an item. Common units may be related to mass, count, linear, area, volume or misc.

isOnlyPotentialParent.description:
Expresses the certainty whether the part has been used as component or input material in the produced item. If the value is false, it can be assumed that the part has been used. If the value is true, there are alternatives for that part, and it is unknown if this part item or an alternative part item has been used.
This is the case when, e.g. the same item is supplied by two suppliers, and the item is only tracked by a customer part ID during assembly. Thus, these items cannot be differentiated from each other.

businessPartner.description: The supplier of the given child item.

createdOn.description: Timestamp when the relation between the parent part and the child part was created

lastModifiedOn.description: Timestamp when the assembly or usage relationship between parent part and child part was last modified.

globalAssetId.description: The fully anonymous ID in the dataspace of the part.

customers.description:
Property. Model:'urn:samm:io.catenax.shared.industry_core.common:1.0.0#customers'. A list of all customers of this item. If the parent items in which this item is assembled into are known, they should be listed as well.

For serialized items the list should contain only one customer with one parent item.
As different subsets of a batch might be sold to different customers this is a list.

items.description: The provided regular expression ensures that the BPNL is composed of prefix 'BPNL', 10 digits and two alphanumeric letters.

globalAssetId.description: Property. Model:'urn:samm:io.catenax.shared.industry_core.common:1.0.0#globalAssetId'. The fully anonymous ID in the dataspace of the part.
